notes.title: Big Zombie Update and leaving Early-Access
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26859637/aaebd4ee1755f1bcb5d82254fb44c67423c84654.jpg[/img]
[b]Header Goal VR: Being Axel Rix has just left Early-Access with a big ZOMBIE update. [/b]

[h1][b]Zombie Trailer is here:[/b][/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3xGiO46ypzs
[h1][b]What does the new update offer for VR gamers?[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*]The story of Axel Rix goes on and takes a turn after he meets Agent S.C.A.R.Z who is an alien.
    [*] In addition to the training episode there is brand new zombie episode including 10 chapters.
    [*] Zombies! FYI: They can dance.
    [*] A Boss Fight
    [*] Balls: Burning, freezing, exploding and moving like missiles.
    [*] Now Axel has “Bazooka Head”. His head turns into a bazooka firing cannon balls.
    [*] Traps, holes, destructible objects
    [*] And so much fun!
[/list]

notes.title: Star Ratings Revised - Update!
notes.content:

Now; with this update all star ratings are revised to give you much better experience throughout the whole Training Episode.
